solarpunk botanist, near-future, rendered as graphite concept art concept art moodboard, high-contrast teal-and-orange, frosted glass

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'solarpunk botanist, near-future, rendered as graphite concept art'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens. Lighting reference: a projected gobo throwing a broken pattern across the background.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'solarpunk botanist, near-future, rendered as graphite concept art'.

PANEL. This branch renders the three-quarter left: 45 degrees to camera-left, weight on the back foot.

DESIGN LOCK. The upstream art-direction synthesis fixes silhouette, palette, material story, age, build and every signature prop. Restate those specifics in your prompt and change nothing — a turnaround only works if all panels describe the identical character.

MATERIALS. Specify at least four materials by name — oiled walnut, crushed velvet and others — with their wear state, and grade to a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.
